sections.heading: Overview

sections.content: Scope of Work will include ASA800 expenditure and ASAE 3150 control audits across FY2025/2026, FY2026/2027 and FY2027/2028.
sections.heading: Project goals

sections.content:
The scope for the procurement tender is based on the audit activity for three (3) financial years of Disaster Recovery Funding Arrangements expenditure incurred from 2025/2026 to 2027/2028 inclusive.See attached RFQ Part A document for details.

Timeline:

RFQ issued-28/08/2026

Receipt of supplier intentions to participate in RFQ and submit Third Party Conflict of Interest form (send the form to contact person email details in this document)-04/09/2026

End date for any RFQ supplier clarifications-18/09/2026

RFQ close date-24/09/2026

Supplier meetings (if required)-TBA

Evaluation of responses and select supplier-24/09/2026-20/10/2026
sections.heading: Scope

sections.content:
1.
Part B Response template
Part B Response template

Please note the following requirements when submitting your response:

- Part B Response Template must be fully completed and submitted as part of the pack.
- Macros have been disabled to allow successful uploading of the file.
- File name should be kept short when submitting your responses to ensure smooth upload and processing.

Responses to the schedule S.2 to S.4 can be submitted in pdf or PowerPoint version, each section not exceeding 5 pages.

S.5 Pricing and Resource mix must be completed in the Part B template (additionally detailed cost breakdown with resources aligning with deliverables and timelines can be submitted in pdf or PowerPoint version limited to 2 pages).

Response type
File upload (Multiple)

2.
Third Party Data Sharing Deed Poll & Attachment A Special Conditions

This will be for selected supplier to sign off. Clauses in this document are for refrence as per the requirements of project and may update based on proposal submitted.

If you have question regarding these two documents please advise via Q&A section of this RFQ prior to supplier clarification date 18.09.2026.

Response type
Free text

3.
Receipt of supplier intentions to participate in RFQ

Receipt of supplier intentions to participate in RFQ- Friday, 04/09/2026

Please confirm via Q&A section if you intend to participate.

Response type
Free text

4.
Third Party Conflict of Interest form

All Suppliers must complete this document and submit by 18/09/2026 if you are intending to participate in this procurement process.

Send the completed form to contact person email details

Contact Officer: Ambika Girglani, Senior Procurement Officer

Contact Email: rfx-responses@reconstruction.nsw.gov.au

Response type
Free text

5.
Evidence & Confirmation of your organisation's current audit registration

Provide evidence such as ASIC registration details, audit licence/registration certificates, and compliance statements demonstrating adherence to ongoing statutory obligations and conditions of company audit registration.

Fail to provide relevant documents will lead to disqualification.

Please accept yes in your response if you have submitted the relevant documents.

File name convention- Your Organisation name_Document name

Response type
Radio button (Yes/No)

6.
Experience successfully delivering audits within the Government compliance environment?

Please provide evidence and references demonstrating your organisation’s successful delivery of audit services within a government compliance environment. Please indicate “Yes” or “No” to confirm whether the required supporting documentation and references are included in your submission. Failure to provide relevant evidence may result in disqualification.

Response type
Radio button (Yes/No)
